title: VTC Admin Events — Event — payload
description: One hint, sent by a Verifiable Trust Community down an administrator console's live channel: something under `topic` changed, re-read it. It never carries the record that changed. Fire-and-forget: there is no response. The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

topic.description: What changed. Always one of the effective topics the subscribe response named.

at.description: When the community observed the change. Where it coalesced several changes into this hint, the latest of them.

count.description: Only on a count topic (`actions`, `acknowledgements`, `joinRequests`): the caller's current count for that topic as of `at` — what a console badge shows. Absent on every other topic. A console MAY show it until its re-fetch returns, and MUST prefer the read's own count once it does.

resumeToken.description: The stream position after this hint. A console keeps the latest one and passes it back as `since` when it re-subscribes.
